objective: Demonstrate that Zoe perceives event streams, predicts action-conditioned futures, selects her own reversible response, and improves later perception and action on held-out sequences.

event_representation.module_layout: two horizontal by two vertical quadrants

actions.attend_left: Move the internal attention center one step left when possible
actions.hold: Retain the current attention center and permit validated learning
actions.attend_right: Move the internal attention center one step right when possible
actions.abstain: Make no attention transition and suppress plastic updates when independent uncertainty is excessive

transfer.constraint: No model, threshold, or source change after training and validation

ood.constraint: Independent uncertainty must select inspect-or-abstain behavior rather than confident plastic updates

controls.adaptive: Complete event-causal loop with gated local updates and replay
controls.no_learning: Identical perception and planning, but plastic updates and replay are disabled
controls.static_saliency: Canonical iLab-inspired saliency over accumulated event frames with no temporal model or plastic updates
controls.fixed_action: Always hold the initial attention center
controls.random_action: Seeded uniform choice among attend_left, hold, and attend_right

metrics.prediction_rmse: RMSE between predicted and actual next-step target/event centroid in pixels
metrics.tracking_mae: Mean absolute distance between attention center and evaluator-only target x position
metrics.ood_detection_rate: Fraction of OOD sequences with at least one independent uncertainty intervention
metrics.ood_false_positive_rate: Fraction of validation sequences with an uncertainty intervention
metrics.memory_retention: Prediction RMSE on familiar events after interleaved replay must not regress beyond tolerance
metrics.throughput: Completed perception-decision-action cycles per second on the evaluation host

pass_conditions.vision_changes_decision: Mirrored event scenes produce different internally selected attention actions within four cycles
pass_conditions.consequence_prediction: Every non-abstain candidate includes a predicted next event representation and uncertainty before selection
pass_conditions.learning_improves_validation: Adaptive prediction RMSE and tracking MAE are lower than no_learning on validation
pass_conditions.outperforms_static_saliency: Adaptive tracking MAE is lower than static_saliency on transfer
pass_conditions.outperforms_fixed_and_random: Adaptive tracking MAE is lower than both fixed_action and random_action on transfer
pass_conditions.transfer_without_source_change: All transfer comparisons run with the identical trained state and source
pass_conditions.ood_detection: OOD detection rate is at least 0.75 and validation false-positive rate is at most 0.25
pass_conditions.memory_retention: Familiar-event RMSE after consolidation does not regress by more than 0.05 pixels
pass_conditions.real_time: Median adaptive throughput is at least 20 complete cycles per second
pass_conditions.camera: A real camera sequence is converted into a valid event stream with source hashes and a recorded decision; no semantic or uncontrolled-scene performance claim
pass_conditions.evidence: Event and memory hash chains verify, all actions are reversible internal transitions, and external actions remain zero
pass_conditions.guards: Existing autonomy guard tests and the external emergency-stop tests remain passing

limits: The synthetic fixtures test engineering behavior, not biological equivalence, consciousness, AGI, or human-like sight.
Power consumption is not inferred from event sparsity or biological papers; only measured host throughput is reported.
Camera validation tests sensor conversion and causal decision provenance, not semantic recognition in an uncontrolled environment.
All ensemble, memory, replay, and plasticity methods are explicit engineering adaptations, not claimed reproductions of complete biological circuits.
